title: 第13章 药田危机不速之客上第14章 药田危机剑齿初鸣下
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
＞铁爪刚进化成剑齿猫武士，屋外就传来刺耳的猫叫与打斗声。
＞林墨冲出石屋，只见三个御兽宗外门弟子正贪婪地盯着猫薄荷田。
＞“废物林墨，还没死透？这田里的灵草和野猫，赵管事全要了！”
为首的王莽狞笑着一掌拍向挡路的铁爪。
＞剑齿猫武士眼中金芒暴涨，利爪撕裂空气——
＞嗤啦！
淡金色的爪痕精准切开王莽手臂，鲜血瞬间染红银灰叶片！
＞另外两人惊得倒退数步，猫群发出兴奋嘶鸣。
林墨缓步上前，猫尾在身后无意识地摆动。
＞“王师兄，我的猫，我的田，不劳费心。”
＞王莽捂着手臂，怨毒地盯着林墨头顶的猫耳：“好！
你们等着！
赵管事不会放过你们的！”
三人狼狈逃离。
＞危机暂解，林墨却皱紧眉头。
他目光扫过灵田，忽然定住——卷尾三花猫阿玳正焦急地围着某株猫薄荷打转，爪子还扒拉着废弃丹炉里的药渣……
---
石屋内，淡金色的气旋余韵尚未完全散去，空气中弥漫着一种铁与血淬炼后的凛冽气息。
铁爪——曾经的铁爪虎斑猫，如今的剑齿猫武士——静静伫立在林墨面前。
它矫健的身躯线条流畅紧绷，覆盖着一层隐隐泛着金属冷光的短毛，最慑人的是口中那对探出唇外的森白剑齿，寒芒流转，仿佛能轻易洞穿金石。

暗金色的瞳孔里，野性的凶悍沉淀下去，取而代之的是一种近乎磐石的沉稳与清晰的守护意志。
它微微低头，喉咙里滚出一声低沉而郑重的呼噜，如同战士在向主君宣誓效忠。
林墨心中激荡，正想伸手摸摸这新晋的守护者，好好感受这份蜕变的力量。
“喵嗷——！
！”
一声凄厉尖锐到几乎撕裂耳膜的猫叫，猛地穿透了石屋单薄的墙壁！
紧随其后的，是数声充满威胁与愤怒的嘶吼，以及混乱的、带着惊慌的猫群骚动声！
铁爪瞬间抬头，颈部的毛发如钢针般炸起，暗金瞳孔缩成一条细线，锁定了门外。
content_en:
>Iron Claw had just evolved into a saber-toothed cat warrior when harsh meows and fighting sounds were heard outside the house.
>Lin Mo rushed out of the stone house and saw three outer disciples of the Beast Control Sect staring greedily at the catnip field.
> "You useless Lin Mo, isn't he dead yet? Manager Zhao wants all the spiritual grass and wild cats in this field!"
The leader, Wang Mang, smiled ferociously and slapped the iron claw blocking the way.
>The golden light in the eyes of the saber-toothed cat warrior surged, and the sharp claws tore through the air——
＞Tsk!
The pale golden claw marks cut Wang Mang's arm accurately, and the blood instantly dyed the silver-gray leaves red!
>The other two people were so shocked that they took a few steps back, and the cats neighed in excitement.
Lin Mo stepped forward slowly, his cat's tail swaying unconsciously behind him.
> "Senior Brother Wang, my cats and my fields don't need to be taken care of."
>Wang Mang covered his arms and stared at the cat ears on Lin Mo's head resentfully: "Okay!
Just wait!
Manager Zhao will not let you go! "
The three people fled in panic.
>The crisis was temporarily resolved, but Lin Mo frowned.
His eyes swept across the spiritual field and suddenly stopped - the curly-tailed calico cat Ah Dai was anxiously circling a certain catnip plant, his claws still pulling at the dregs of medicine in the abandoned alchemy furnace...
---
In the stone house, the afterglow of the pale golden cyclone has not completely dissipated, and the air is filled with a cold aura tempered by iron and blood.
Iron Claw - the former Iron Claw tabby cat, now the saber-tooth cat warrior - stood quietly in front of Lin Mo.
The lines of its strong body are smooth and tight, covered with a layer of short hair that has a faint metallic cold light. The most impressive thing is the pair of white saber teeth protruding from the lips. The cold light flows, as if it can easily penetrate gold and stone.
In the dark golden pupils, the wild ferocity settled down, and was replaced by an almost rock-like calmness and clear protective will.
It lowered its head slightly and let out a low and solemn purr from its throat, like a warrior swearing allegiance to his master.
Lin Mo's heart was agitated, and he was about to reach out and touch this new guardian to feel the power of transformation.
"Meow-!"
! "
A cat meow that was so shrill that it almost tore my eardrums suddenly penetrated the thin wall of the stone house!
What followed were several threatening and angry roars, as well as the chaotic, panicked commotion of the cats!
Iron Claw raised his head instantly, the hair on his neck exploded like steel needles, and the dark gold pupils shrank into a thin line, locking the door.
